subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 06, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 06, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS community,

We're excited to share the latest updates from the AcreetionOS team. This week has been filled with progress on various fronts, and we're eager to share the highlights with you.

On the development side, Darren has been working tirelessly on Calamares customization and extending its capabilities for AcreetionOS. His efforts have resulted in a smoother first-boot experience for users, ensuring that their transition to our distribution is seamless. Meanwhile, Natalie has been busy refining the user interface and user experience, making sure that our distro remains user-friendly and intuitive.

In the realm of infrastructure, we've made significant strides in improving our GitLab instance. The new setup has enhanced performance and reliability, making it easier for our community members to collaborate and contribute to the project. We're grateful for the feedback and suggestions from our users, which have been instrumental in shaping the improvements.

Our community has been growing steadily, and we're thrilled to welcome new members who share our passion for a sovereign and private Linux distribution. If you're new to AcreetionOS, we encourage you to join our Discord server and get involved in the discussions. Your input and ideas are invaluable to us.

As we continue to work towards our goal of creating a user-friendly and privacy-focused Linux distribution, we're committed to transparency and open communication. We'll keep you updated on our progress and appreciate your continued support.

In other news, Natalie's Fluorite browser has seen significant updates, with improved ad-blocking and privacy enhancements. If you haven't checked it out yet, we recommend giving it a try.

Darren's gaming sessions have been keeping him busy, with 300+ hours spent in 7 Days to Die and countless hours conquering empires in Civilization VI & VII. His gaming expertise has even inspired new ideas for our project, which we're excited to explore.

We're proud to announce that our community has grown to include users from diverse backgrounds and skill levels. Our goal is to create a welcoming environment where everyone can contribute and learn from each other. If you have any questions or need help, don't hesitate to reach out to our community members or the team directly.

As we move forward, we're committed to maintaining our focus on user experience, community engagement, and innovation. We're grateful for your support and look forward to sharing more updates with you in the coming weeks.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to see what the future holds for our project and look forward to your continued involvement.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
